statement: The fixed-panel full-cutoff extractor passes 39 feature tests and 12 default tests and builds successfully. New stub-solver controls require every catalog chart in a complete empty union, reject a completed prefix followed by a later failure, advance forms only after the known nonseparation refusal, and stop on expired budget or required capture exhaustion. The existing cofactor source is unchanged. These are producer-local software controls, with no new scientific query result or cost comparison yet.
